AI skills for BYgram plugins

Use a coding agent to write, port, package and test BYgram plugins.

Install without cloning

Download the Python skill installer. From your downloads folder, run it with Python 3.10 or later. The skill links to the online SDK documentation. The installer includes examples, the packager and the exteraGram converter.

To install for one client, append codex, claude, gemini, cursor, copilot or deepseek. If python is unavailable, use py on Windows or python3 on Linux and macOS.

Use the skill

Start a new agent session. Use $bygram-plugin in Codex or /bygram-plugin in Claude Code and Copilot in VS Code. In Gemini CLI or Cursor, ask the agent to use bygram-plugin. For DeepSeek, open the prompt at the path printed by the installer and paste it into chat. If the chat cannot open links, add the relevant excerpts from the documentation website.

Example request: “Add a chat menu item that shows a configurable tip. Build the .byplugin and list the checks you ran.”
